about: Hand-designed centre of the Hollow (Hollow world thread, 2026-11-10). Mateo: 'The main center where you spawn in and where you can explore will all be custom: have paths, have the villages, have custom structures, whatever. Bridges'. Everything past it stays generated. Positions were checked against undertow/terrain.js heightAt and rivers.js riverDistance: every site is dry, within 5 blocks of flat over a 14-block radius, and at least 22 blocks from a river. Names are working names, not confirmed by Mateo. Merge into undertow/roads.js (SITES, ROADS); roads here run site to site, so ROADS needs a 'from' as well as 'leaveZ'.

extent.note: south of the Court wall; north of it stays as it is

sites.name: Pilgrim's Cross
sites.what: West crossroads. Stone signpost with four arms, a lamp, a bench, a waystone-style marker. No building.

sites.name: Cartmeet
sites.what: East crossroads where the ore carts turn. Signpost, lamp, an empty cart on a short rail stub.

sites.name: The Truce Hall
sites.what: Long stone hall with a broken roof where the truce was signed. One table, two chairs, one of them overturned. Lore thread places a tome here.

sites.name: The Far Door
sites.what: The Hollow's side of the Gate in the far west wall: a tall sealed arch in the rock, scaffolds and dig pits in front of it.

sites.name: The Lattice Wood
sites.what: Small clearing where the lane ends at the edge of the thick Latticewood forest. Keep trees dense around it (raise tree chance within 120 blocks), a woodcutter's lean-to, a stack of cut lattice.

sites.name: The Drift
sites.what: Foot of the floating rocks: the first three rocks hang low enough to jump to. A lookout marker at the top is a later job.

sites.name: The Seams
sites.what: Open ore face in a cliff, richer Choir Ore than anywhere south of the Court. Timbered mouth, rail to Cartmeet.

sites.name: The Wound landing
sites.what: First dock a new arrival sees. Plank dock, one moored Latticewood Boat frame (prop), a lamp, a signpost: Glimwade by water, the Spine on foot.

sites.name: The Cold Forge
sites.what: Ruined open-sided smithy on the high eastern terraces past the Seams, no road up. Dead hearth, tall chimney with soul fire on top, anvils, quench trough, armour racks. Its Coffer holds the only Choirsteel Upgrade template (scripts/undertow/forge.js).

roads.surface: road with a single cart rail down the middle

bridges.name: The Long Arch
bridges.style: three stone arches, the showpiece from Mateo's bridge picture; replaces the flat deck
one wide arch, one parapet broken
timber trestle carrying the cart rail

rules: Bridge decks sit at y 67 or higher (water is y 62) with the arch open underneath, so a boat passes under every bridge. Roads ramp up to the deck.
Bridge crossings were found on straight lines between sites. Once the roads wander, place each bridge where its road really meets the water (riverDistance <= 3.5) and treat the x, z here as a guide.
Roads are 4 wide, cobbled deepslate with worn edges, a lamp post about every 24 blocks on alternating sides. Tracks and paths are 2 wide with no lamps.
A signpost stands where every road leaves the story path and at both crossroads, naming what is down each arm.
Nothing lines up: no two sites share an x or z, and the two crossroads are not opposite each other across the Spine.
Sites flatten the ground like the villages do. Generated landmarks, trees and spires stay out of sites and off roads, as they already do for the existing ones.
